purpose: U30F F4: a replace promote computes two full-table digests under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE inside one interactive transaction of transaction_timeout_ms. For a target listed here, the promote and the retention backfill are refused until a measured digest time is recorded (status MEASURED, reviewed commit) and digests_under_lock x measured_digest_seconds fits within lock_budget_fraction of the timeout. The timeout is also the promote transaction's timeout (import-librarian-manifest reads it from here). There is no runtime override.

The verifier's estimate (PGlite 124 us/row, native 2-4x faster, larger EWKB) puts one digest at 2-9 minutes, so two digests under the exclusive lock likely exceed the 600 s transaction and block every read of the table while they run.
